title: MULTIPLAYER SEQUEL TO ACCLAIMED AAAA GAME “THE LAST MEADOW” ANNOUNCED: PLAYABLE NOW
summary: Band together with Discordians from across the world in Last Meadow Online, the world’s first DBMMIRPG. Available to play until April 7, 2026.
body:
After a harrowing adventure through flourishing forests, desolate deserts, and punishing plains, Wumpus has finally achieved physical contact with The Last Meadow. As they return to town to bask in their accomplishment, the celebration is cut short by a new emerging threat, a fearsome, foliage-absorbing dragon who goes by: Grass Toucher.  

This time, Wumpus will need help... a lot of it. 

Today, we’re announcing the next entry in Big Wump Games’ beloved, now quintuple-A gaming franchise: Last Meadow Online. Band together with your fellow Discordians in the world’s first DBMMIRPG* and help Wumpus defeat Grass Toucher. 

Playable directly within Discord on desktop, you’ll be able to collaborate with adventurers from around the globe. Wield the light of a Paladin, the hawkeyes of a Ranger, or the healing graces of a Priest. Lend your handiwork skills to the cause. 

Play the entire game, directly in Discord, right now. 

Play Last Meadow Online

All players who contribute to defeating Grass Toucher will receive a limited edition badge on their Discord profile, so tell your friends. Last Meadow Online is available to play until April 7, and Wumpus needs all the help they can get. 

*Discord-Based Massively Multiplayer Incremental Role Playing Game
